key.name: active-provider
key.description: Which wallpaper provider to use: wallhaven, pexels, unsplash, safebooru, or pixabay.

key.name: selected-providers
key.description: List of wallpaper providers selected for multi-provider search.

key.name: language
key.description: Language for the preferences interface. Supported: en, pt_BR, es.

key.name: api-key
key.description: Wallhaven API key. Obtain at wallhaven.cc/settings/account — required for NSFW content.

key.name: pexels-api-key
key.description: Pexels API key. Obtain at pexels.com/api — required to use Pexels as provider.

key.name: unsplash-api-key
key.description: Unsplash API key. Obtain at unsplash.com/developers — required to use Unsplash as provider.

key.name: pixabay-api-key
key.description: Pixabay API key. Obtain at pixabay.com/api/docs — required to use Pixabay as provider.

key.name: search-query
key.description: Search term for wallpapers. Leave empty to show recent wallpapers.

key.name: categories
key.description: Category filter: 3 digits (0/1) for general, anime, people. Example: '111' = all, '100' = general only.

key.name: purity
key.description: Purity filter: 3 digits (0/1) for SFW, Sketchy, NSFW. Example: '100' = SFW only. NSFW requires API key.

key.name: sorting
key.description: How to sort results: date_added, relevance, random, views, favorites, toplist.

key.name: order
key.description: Sort direction: desc (descending) or asc (ascending).

key.name: top-range
key.description: Time range for toplist sorting: 1d, 3d, 1w, 1M, 3M, 6M, 1y.

key.name: atleast
key.description: Minimum resolution in WIDTHxHEIGHT format. Example: '1920x1080'. Leave empty for any.

key.name: resolutions
key.description: Exact resolutions, comma-separated. Example: '1920x1080,2560x1440'.

key.name: ratios
key.description: Aspect ratios, comma-separated. Example: '16x9,16x10,21x9'.

key.name: colors
key.description: Color filter in hexadecimal (6 digits). Example: '660000' for dark red.

key.name: ai-art-filter
key.description: Filter out AI-generated content. Enabled by default to exclude AI wallpapers.

key.name: download-folder
key.description: Folder to save full-resolution downloaded images. Leave empty for ~/Pictures/Mopivo.

key.name: set-background
key.description: Automatically set downloaded wallpaper as desktop background.

key.name: page-size
key.description: Number of wallpapers per page (1-24).

key.name: local-folders
key.description: Additional folders for the Local Files provider, besides the Pictures folder. Configured in the Providers settings page as a colon-separated list.

key.name: local-recursive
key.description: Recursively search subfolders in the Local Files provider.

key.name: video-mode
key.description: When enabled, the panel switches from image browsing to video wallpaper mode.

key.name: video-mode-type
key.description: Source of the video wallpaper: local (file), streaming (yt-dlp URL), or webpage (WebKit).

key.name: video-path
key.description: Path or URI of the local video used as wallpaper in video mode.

key.name: video-folder
key.description: Folder scanned for random ("I'm Feeling Lucky") and auto-change video selection, and where online videos are downloaded. Leave empty for ~/Videos/Mopivo.

key.name: video-provider
key.description: Provider used by the online video gallery: pexels or pixabay.

key.name: video-search-query
key.description: Last search term used in the online video gallery.

key.name: video-streaming-url
key.description: Streaming URL (e.g. YouTube) resolved with yt-dlp for the video wallpaper.

key.name: video-webpage-url
key.description: Webpage URL rendered as wallpaper in webpage mode.

key.name: video-webpage-local-html
key.description: Local HTML file rendered as wallpaper in webpage mode.

key.name: video-volume
key.description: Audio volume of the video wallpaper (0-100).

key.name: video-mute
key.description: Mute the video wallpaper audio.

key.name: video-fade-duration-sec
key.description: Duration in seconds of the volume fade when muting/unmuting.

key.name: video-audio-primary-monitor-only
key.description: Play audio only on the primary monitor; secondary monitors are muted.

key.name: video-fit-mode
key.description: How the video is fitted on screen: fill, contain, cover, or scale-down.

key.name: video-random-start
key.description: Seek to a random position when the video wallpaper starts.

key.name: video-monitor-paths
key.description: Videos assigned to specific monitors, as "monitor=path" entries. Monitors without an entry use the default video path. Example: ["HDMI-1=/path/a.mp4","eDP-1=/path/b.mp4"].

key.name: pause-on-maximize-or-fullscreen
key.description: Pause the video wallpaper when a window is maximized or fullscreen: 0 = never, 1 = any monitor, 2 = all monitors.

key.name: pause-on-focus
key.description: Pause the video wallpaper whenever any window has focus.

key.name: pause-on-battery
key.description: Pause the video wallpaper based on power status: 0 = never, 1 = low battery, 2 = always on battery.

key.name: low-battery-threshold
key.description: Battery percentage below which the video wallpaper pauses when pause-on-battery is set to low battery.

key.name: pause-on-mpris-playing
key.description: Pause the video wallpaper whenever a media player (MPRIS) is playing.

key.name: change-wallpaper
key.description: Periodically change the video wallpaper from a directory.

key.name: change-wallpaper-directory-path
key.description: Directory scanned when auto-change is enabled. Falls back to the video folder.

key.name: change-wallpaper-interval
key.description: Minutes between automatic wallpaper changes.

key.name: change-wallpaper-mode
key.description: Order used when changing wallpapers: 0 = sequential, 1 = reverse, 2 = random.

key.name: static-wallpaper-from-video
key.description: Extract a frame from the video and set it as the static desktop background (GNOME only).

key.name: static-wallpaper-blur-enabled
key.description: Blur the extracted static frame before setting it as wallpaper.

key.name: static-wallpaper-blur-radius
key.description: Gaussian blur radius applied to the static wallpaper frame.

key.name: wallpaper-mode
key.description: How a wallpaper is applied across monitors: same (same image on every monitor), span (one image spanned across all monitors), or per-monitor (one image assigned per connector).

key.name: wallpaper-per-monitor
key.description: Wallpapers assigned to specific monitors, as "connector=uri" entries. Example: ["HDMI-1=file:///path/a.jpg","eDP-1=file:///path/b.jpg"].

key.name: wallpaper-default-uri
key.description: Default wallpaper URI used when a monitor has no per-monitor assignment. Leave empty for none.

key.name: show-on-lock-screen
key.description: Keep the video wallpaper visible on the lock screen. When disabled, playback pauses while locked.

key.name: startup-delay
key.description: Renderer startup delay in milliseconds before initializing the video subsystem.

key.name: show-panel-menu
key.description: Whether the notification/panel indicator for video mode is shown (kept for schema compatibility even though the app has no panel menu).

key.name: enable-va
key.description: Enable VA-API hardware acceleration in the renderer's GStreamer pipeline.

key.name: enable-nvsl
key.description: Enable NVIDIA NVDEC/NVENC hardware acceleration in the renderer's GStreamer pipeline.

key.name: prefer-clappersink
key.description: Prefer clapper sink over gtk4paintablesink when building the renderer pipeline.

key.name: force-mediafile
key.description: Force the GstPlay/Gtk.MediaFile playback path instead of the manual playbin pipeline.

key.name: generator-preset
key.description: Last shader preset selected in the wallpaper Generator: Bars, Circle, Plasma, Waves, Terrain, Dunes or Spark.

key.name: generator-palette
key.description: Absolute path of the last palette image used by the wallpaper Generator.

key.name: generator-resolution
key.description: Export resolution index: 0 Display, 1 HD (1920x1080), 2 QHD (2560x1440), 3 4K (3840x2160), 4 Phone (1080x2400).

key.name: generator-format
key.description: Image format used when exporting a generated wallpaper: png or jpg.

key.name: generator-export-folder
key.description: Folder where generated wallpapers are saved. Empty uses the XDG Pictures directory.
